people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

translations.web: But others said, “He is Elijah.” Others said, “He is a prophet, or like one of the prophets.”
translations.bsb: Others were saying, “He is Elijah,” and still others, “He is a prophet, like one of the prophets of old.”
translations.kjv: Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.
